query: SELECT e.id, e.status FROM workflow_executions e JOIN lib_fsm.state_machine sm ON sm.state_machine__id = e.status JOIN lib_fsm.abstract_state abs ON abs.abstract_state__id = sm.abstract_state__id WHERE abs.name IN ('pending', 'will_retry', 'running') AND (e.next_retry_at IS NULL OR e.next_retry_at <= now()) AND (e.locked_until IS NULL OR e.locked_until <= now()) ORDER BY e.next_retry_at ASC FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
